entities.name: Soji of Silla
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Soji was Ruler of Silla. He was preceded by Jabi Maripgan (458–479) and succeeded by King Jijeung (500–514). According to the Samguk sagi, there was significant development of road infrastructure during his reign.
